uninstall.title: Uninstall any previous version in NinjaTrader 8
uninstall.intro: If you already have a previous version of the indicators installed on your system, you must uninstall it first before proceeding to avoid library conflicts or errors in NinjaTrader 8. If this is your first time installing, click Next.

substeps.title: Open NinjaTrader 8 and open the uninstall tool
substeps.description: Open NinjaTrader 8 and follow the three steps shown in the screenshots below to remove previous assemblies. In the top menu, go to Tools (Step 1) and click on Remove NinjaScript Assembly... (Step 2).

substeps.title: Remove all files starting with LOF
substeps.description: In the 'Remove NinjaScript Assembly' window (Step 3), you must select and remove ALL files and assemblies that begin with the letters LOF (for example: LOFData, LOFDepthData, LOFDepthEngine, LOFEngine, LOF_FullPack, LOF_BasicPack, LOF_DepthPack, etc.). Select them and click the Remove button to completely delete them.

substeps.title: Restart NinjaTrader 8 if you uninstalled files
substeps.description: If you removed files from a previous version, close NinjaTrader 8 completely and reopen it before installing the new package. This restart ensures NinjaTrader 8 memory is clean and free of conflicts.

uninstall.closingNote: Note: If this is your first time installing Logic Indicators and you do not have any previous version in NinjaTrader 8, you do not need to do anything here. Click Next to proceed directly to the installation process.

tutorial.title: How to install indicators in NinjaTrader 8
tutorial.intro: Before we continue with your pack file, let's review the general install process. Every indicator follows these same steps.

substeps.title: Download the file to your computer
substeps.description: Save the file in a folder you can remember — your Desktop is fine. You will need it in the next step.

substeps.title: Install the pack in NinjaTrader 8
substeps.description: Open NinjaTrader 8, then follow the two steps shown in the screenshots below to import the file you just downloaded. Each image shows one step of the process — first the import action, then the confirmation dialog.

substeps.title: Wait for the confirmation, then restart NinjaTrader 8
substeps.description: When the import process finishes, NinjaTrader 8 will show a confirmation message. Once you see it, close NinjaTrader 8 completely and reopen it. This step is critical — without a restart, the indicators will not load and they will not appear on your charts.

tutorial.closingNote: Got it. From the next step onwards, download the file and apply the same process in NinjaTrader 8 shown above. If NinjaTrader 8 shows any prompts during the install, follow the on-screen instructions.

products.title: Download your pack
products.description: Click the button below to download your pack. Then follow the install steps in NinjaTrader 8 shown in the previous tutorial. The licensing for the indicators you have active is validated on the backend, so you will only be able to use the ones you bought.

success.title: Restart NinjaTrader 8
success.description: Close and reopen NinjaTrader 8 so the new file loads. After the restart, your indicators are ready to use — you can apply them to any chart.
success.actionNote: This is the last step. When you restart, everything is configured.
